Drive land-and-expand opportunities that extend engagements into broader transformation programs.Grow initial data or AI engagements into broader integrated data-and-AI transformation programs over time.</li> <li><strong>Internal Leadership &amp; Market Positioning: </strong>Operate as part of the Data &amp; AI leadership team, shaping strategy, targets, and vertical plays. Contribute to Thoughtworks' external positioning through industry-relevant narratives and insights.Represent Thoughtworks' point of view on integrated data and AI transformation, grounded in how strong data foundations enable successful AI outcomes.</li> </ul> </div> <h2 id="job-qualifications">Job qualifications</h2> <div class="job-qualifications content"> <h3 id="technical-skills">Technical Skills</h3> <div class="qualifications inner-content"> <ul> <li>Proven track record of originating and shaping large ($3-5M+) consulting or transformation deals and opportunities in Data &amp; AI or adjacent domains.</li> <li>Strong commercial acumen with the ability to build pipeline, shape deals, and drive conversion through Data &amp; AI opportunities and transformation leadership.</li> <li>Senior industry or consulting experience with credibility at executive levels.</li> <li>Deep understanding of how Data &amp; AI capabilities translate into business outcomes.</li> <li>Ability to operate within account structures, owning development and progression domain opportunities while collaborating with Client Partners.</li> <li>Strong collaboration with Practice Leaders to ensure solutions are both compelling and deliverable.</li> <li>Excellent executive communication, storytelling, and negotiation skills.</li> <li>Strong experience in business value delivery and ROI generation with advanced AI solutions across industries e.g. BFSI, Manufacturing, Travel, Telecom, Media, Gaming, Life Sciences.</li> <li>Strong practical understanding across the data and AI stack — platforms, governance, and AI/ML — sufficient to independently explore client problems, define transformation opportunities, establish solution direction and work&nbsp; credibly with technical teams.</li> <li>Ability to articulate value cases spanning data modernization and AI adoption, showing a connected path from data investment to AI-driven outcomes. Ability to move between executive business conversations and technical discussions, translating client needs into transformation opportunities that are commercially compelling and technically credible.</li> </ul> </div> <h3 id="professional-skills">Professional Skills</h3> <div class="skills inner-content"> <ul> <li>Key Outcomes.</li> <li>Contribution to $30M+ in bookings through ownership and progression and shaping of high value Data &amp; AI opportunities.</li> <li>Sustained pipeline of multiple $3–5M+ deals across geography and industries.</li> <li>Increased average deal size and improved conversion of Data &amp; AI opportunities through strong opportunity definition, transformation shaping, value articulation and technical credibility.</li> <li>Growth in enterprise-scale, outcome-led Data &amp; AI transformation programs.</li> <li>Strong alignment between sold work and delivery outcomes, enabling repeatable success.</li> <li>Growth in integrated data-and-AI deals (platforms and AI/ML) as a share of overall pipeline and bookings.</li> <li>Increased reuse of successful Data &amp; AI propositions, transformation patterns and solution approaches across markets and accounts.</li> </ul> </div> </div> <h2 id="important-things">Other things to know</h2> <div class="important-things content"> <h3>Learning &amp; Development</h3> <div class="inner-content"> <p>There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.</p> </div> </div> <h2 id="responsible-ai-use">Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment</h2> <div class="responsible-ai-use content"> <p>At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.<br><br>Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.<br><br>We are committed to fairness and responsible AI. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes&nbsp; and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.&nbsp; Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.&nbsp;</li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><h3><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>THE ROLE</strong></span></h3> <p>Director of Specialty Fibers</p> <p>This role ensures that every product made from cashmere, merino, yak, alpaca, and other luxury fibers meets Quince's uncompromising standards for quality, sustainability, and affordability.</p> <p>The Director blends deep technical expertise in fiber science with strategic supply chain leadership and cross-functional collaboration, serving as the central hub connecting sourcing, production, quality, and design teams across global markets.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <h4>Strategic Leadership &amp; Supply Chain Management</h4> <ul> <li>Orchestrate the end-to-end supply chain as the central hub connecting sourcing managers, production teams, and quality specialists to ensure a seamless, resilient, and efficient flow from fiber to finished yarn.</li> <li>Lead and mentor a diverse, specialized team of sourcing managers, quality engineers, and production experts, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and technical excellence.</li> <li>Drive multi-sourcing and nearshoring strategies to mitigate geopolitical and logistical risks while ensuring a stable supply of high-grade fibers from the Americas and Asia.</li> <li>Set the strategic direction for vertical integration opportunities, evaluating build-vs-buy decisions for spinning, dyeing, or finishing capabilities that could enhance quality control and margin structure.</li> <li>Act as a key advisor to the executive team on fiber market trends, geopolitical risks (e.g., trade tariffs, export restrictions), climate impacts on raw material supply, and competitive intelligence—translating complex data into actionable business recommendations.</li> <li>Champion Quince's "unreal prices" mission by continuously identifying cost-leadership opportunities across the supply chain, from farm to finished yarn, without compromising ethical standards or product integrity.</li> </ul> <h4>Sourcing &amp; Supplier Development</h4> <ul> <li>Build and curate a best-in-class supplier ecosystem, identifying, vetting, and onboarding mills, dehairers, spinners, and dye houses that meet Quince's exacting standards for quality, capacity, sustainability, and labor practices.</li> <li>Lead supplier development programs, coaching strategic partners to improve yield, reduce defects, adopt sustainable practices, and achieve cost efficiencies that benefit both parties.</li> <li>Drive traceability and transparency across the entire fiber supply chain, from herder cooperatives and farms to finished yarn. Partner with certification bodies (GOTS, RWS, GCS, ZQ) to ensure chain-of-custody integrity.</li> <li>Make high-stakes sourcing decisions based on deep market intelligence—including auction prices, crop forecasts, currency fluctuations, and geopolitical developments—balancing short-term cost opportunities with long-term relationship value.</li> </ul> <h4>Quality Assurance &amp; Technical Optimization</h4> <ul> <li>Architect the quality management system for all specialty fibers, defining standards, testing protocols, and approval workflows for raw fiber, dehaired fiber, tops, yarns, and finished goods.</li> <li>Partner with the Senior Manager, Natural Fibers Quality to establish measurable quality benchmarks, including micron distribution, fiber length, tensile strength, yield, color fastness, and pilling resistance—ensuring every lot meets or exceeds luxury brand parity.</li> <li>Oversee third-party lab testing and compliance, working with the Cashmere Spec/Test Report/Compliance Auditor to validate that all materials meet international standards (ISO, OEKO-TEX, GOTS, REACH) and Quince's internal specifications.</li> <li>Lead root-cause analysis for quality failures, implementing corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) across the supply chain. Drive a culture of "quality at the source," empowering suppliers to self-detect and correct issues before production.</li> <li>Collaborate with product development and design teams to translate aesthetic and tactile visions into technical specifications—micron targets, twist levels, finishing treatments—that are manufacturable at scale and cost.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h4>Cross-Functional Collaboration</h4> <ul> <li>Serve as the central point of communication for all fiber-related matters, providing technical expertise and clear direction to design, product development, and production teams.</li> <li>Communicate daily with domestic and overseas mills, dye houses, and suppliers to give precise, actionable feedback on fiber quality, color accuracy, availability and production timelines.</li> <li>Translate design and merchandising visions into clear, manufacturable technical briefs for suppliers, ensuring that product aesthetics and performance meet Quince's brand standards.</li> <li>Lead blind panels with design, merchandising, and customer focus groups to validate luxury fiber perception and color accuracy before commercialization.</li> </ul> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3><strong>Qualifications</strong></h3> <h4>Required</h4> <ul> <li>Degree in Textile Science, Fiber Engineering, Material Science, Supply Chain Management, Color Chemistry, or related field.</li> <li>15+ years of experience in specialty fiber sourcing, yarn production, quality management, or coloration for apparel, accessories, or home textiles.</li> <li>Deep technical knowledge of natural fibers (cashmere, merino, yak, alpaca, cotton), spinning processes (woolen, worsted)</li> <li>Proven leadership experience managing cross-functional teams in a fast-paced retail or manufacturing environment, with a track record of mentoring and developing talent.</li> <li>Strong cost analysis skills: cost-per-kilogram modeling, yield optimization, landed cost analysis, and budget management.</li> <li>Experience building and maintaining quality standards, and supplier compliance programs, including SKU rationalization and shade consolidation.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.</li> </ul> <h4>Preferred</h4> <ul> <li>Experience with sustainable fibers</li> <li>Knowledge of supply chain traceability including blockchain or digital tracking systems.</li> <li>Familiarity with PLM systems and quality database management.</li> <li>Background in luxury goods (apparel, home and accessories) with an eye for premium aesthetics, handfeel, and trend forecasting.</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="3604"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><u data-renderer-mark="true">EQUAL OPPORTUNITY &amp; HIRING INTEGRITY</u></strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="3662">Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.&nbsp;</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="4074">Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="4604"><em data-renderer-mark="true">Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds</em></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="4641">At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.</p> <p>Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!</p></div><h2>About the role</h2> <p>Crunchyroll is scaling globally, creating unique challenges and exciting opportunities to delight millions of anime fans worldwide. Joining Skyscanner means becoming part of a global brand that's striving to become the planet's go-to travel hack accessible for all 🌍. Our vision? To be the world's number one travel ally. (Ambitious? 💪Yes, but, hey, that's what got us here). Now, we’re on the lookout for a Global PR Lead to help us bring that vision to even more travellers. About the role (Hybrid) This is a role at the heart of our fast-paced, high-volume PR team, helping keep our communications flying in formation across 23 markets worldwide. You’ll be the central point connecting plans, people, budgets, agencies and operations — making sure our global PR machine runs smoothly, efficiently and at scale. Working closely with our Senior Director of Communications, regional PR leads, internal teams and global agency partners, you’ll help turn our international PR strategy into coordinated action. From shaping global initiatives to sharpening the way we plan, measure and operate, you’ll bring the structure that helps brilliant PR ideas travel further. What you’ll be doing Driving global PR planning: You’ll lead the planning process with our global PR agency hub, partnering with the Senior Director of Communications to keep forecasting, budgets, resources and priorities aligned. Turning measurement into momentum: You’ll work closely with our measurement lead to make sure reporting is accurate, useful and connected to the strategies and decisions that matter. Optimising our PR ecosystem: You’ll partner with Procurement and Finance to make sure we have the right suppliers, commercial setup and financial tracking in place to support growth — without the spreadsheet drama. Keeping priorities moving: You’ll traffic-manage inbound requests, help the team navigate competing priorities and make sure resources are focused where they can have the greatest impact. Leading global PR initiatives: You’ll spearhead strategic PR initiatives and special projects beyond our core campaigns, while supporting the delivery of our Awareness strategy and Big Bet activity through PR. Making operations smarter: You’ll lead and collaborate on cross-functional improvements spanning tools and technology, including Tableau, ThoughtSpot, AI and our Product Ops model — finding smarter ways for a global team to work at scale. Creating consistency across markets: You’ll partner with market leads, our global agency hub and Corporate and B2B PR teams to develop playbooks, strengthen processes and drive consistent adoption and delivery across 23 markets. You’ll also manage and develop our PR Coordinator, keeping calendars, finance trackers and reporting firmly on course. About you Global PR operator: You’ve worked in complex, international communications environments and know how to turn lots of moving parts into one joined-up plan. Strategic and operational: You’re equally comfortable shaping a global PR initiative and getting into the detail needed to make it happen. Big picture, meet beautifully organised spreadsheet. Stakeholder savvy: You build trusted relationships across senior leaders, market teams, agencies and cross-functional partners, bringing people together around shared priorities. Agency confident: You know how to get the best from global agency relationships, balancing clear direction, strong partnership and accountability for delivery. Commercially switched-on: You’re comfortable working with budgets, forecasting, suppliers, Procurement and Finance, and you understand how strong operational foundations help teams achieve more. Tech and data curious: You’re interested in how measurement, dashboards, AI and smarter tools can improve PR operations, reporting and decision-making at scale. Calm in the whirlwind: You thrive in fast-paced environments, can prioritise when everything feels important, and enjoy helping teams work more effectively. You’re also comfortable managing and developing others along the way. What it's like here We are the real deal - no corporate gloss, no empty promises. Just a team of genuinely curious, caring humans ❤️, building things that help travellers explore the world a little easier 🧭. Skyscanner is made up of brilliant humans from every corner of the world. We believe travel makes the world better - and that the same is true of our diverse teams. We're proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and products that are accessible to all ✨. title: Technical Product Manager - DevEx
description: Our mission We're making Africa the first cashless continent. In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash. We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast. Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in... How you'll help us achieve it Your mission is to make it dramatically easier for our engineers to ship features and learn from them quickly, securely, and reliably. You'll aim for small-startup speed while meeting the quality bar of a large financial institution. Velocity here means removing friction and toil from the path between idea and learning, not asking people to work harder. AI is a big part of the opportunity, and we're looking for a PM who is optimistic about its possibilities but pragmatic about what actually works. The goal is not to adopt the latest shiny AI tool; it's to deeply understand your internal users, experiment, and honestly evaluate what solves their problems, whether that's AI, process changes, or boring tooling that just works. The Technical Product Manager - DevEx will: Lead a team of engineers with full ownership of how we deliver new features for our users and use AI solutions to remove impactful friction for our engineers and product managers. Define product goals, metrics, and roadmaps based on user needs and mission impact. Drive user research within our engineering and product teams. Write clear, compelling design docs and facilitate async, fast-moving decision-making. Over-communicate context, priorities, and decisions to ensure team alignment. Adjust priorities quickly based on feedback, experiments, or new learnings. Solve problems holistically, whether through product features, ops tooling or process changes. In this role, you'll... Own the developer experience holistically, including any internal or external tooling needed to support it. Research and implement solutions for how we can use AI to remove engineering and development friction.  Build your own prototypes to test ideas where possible. Relentlessly gather feedback (by talking to users and looking at data) to deeply understand the problem space and our engineers' and product managers' needs. Work from first principles to understand the engineers' and product managers' biggest problems and then figure out how our tooling should work to solve those problems. raw.title: Technical Product Manager - DevEx
raw.description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

Your mission is to make it dramatically easier for our engineers to ship features and learn from them quickly, securely, and reliably. You'll aim for small-startup speed while meeting the quality bar of a large financial institution. Velocity here means removing friction and toil from the path between idea and learning, not asking people to work harder.

AI is a big part of the opportunity, and we're looking for a PM who is optimistic about its possibilities but pragmatic about what actually works. The goal is not to adopt the latest shiny AI tool; it's to deeply understand your internal users, experiment, and honestly evaluate what solves their problems, whether that's AI, process changes, or boring tooling that just works.

The Technical Product Manager - DevEx will:

  • Lead a team of engineers with full ownership of how we deliver new features for our users and use AI solutions to remove impactful friction for our engineers and product managers.
  • Define product goals, metrics, and roadmaps based on user needs and mission impact.
  • Drive user research within our engineering and product teams.
  • Write clear, compelling design docs and facilitate async, fast-moving decision-making.
  • Over-communicate context, priorities, and decisions to ensure team alignment.
  • Adjust priorities quickly based on feedback, experiments, or new learnings.
  • Solve problems holistically, whether through product features, ops tooling or process changes.

In this role, you'll...

  • Own the developer experience holistically, including any internal or external tooling needed to support it.
  • Research and implement solutions for how we can use AI to remove engineering and development friction. 
  • Build your own prototypes to test ideas where possible.
  • Relentlessly gather feedback (by talking to users and looking at data) to deeply understand the problem space and our engineers' and product managers' needs.
  • Work from first principles to understand the engineers' and product managers' biggest problems and then figure out how our tooling should work to solve those problems.
  • Prioritize the biggest problems blocking the engineers' and product managers' productivity and the impact on delivering value to our users fast and securely.
  • Directly manage the DevEx team to help them grow in their careers, partnering with the Tech Lead, who will own the technical bar.

Key Details

  • This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (UK, Spain, USA (East Coast), Canada, Kenya and Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso
  • Wave provides a yearly $1,200 stipend to support co-working meetups with teammates.
  • Remote team members are expected to travel to our operational markets (e.g. Senegal or Côte d'Ivoire) at least once per year. Exceptions apply, but we've found this key to understanding our users and product.
  • Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary up to $237,500 USD, plus a generous equity package.
  • Major benefits:
    • Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents, and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country).
    • 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance.
    • Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 21-30 days per year. 
    • $10,000 annual charitable donation matching.

Requirements

  • Have 3+ years of product management experience and hands-on engineering background (you've shipped production code) or direct PM ownership of a developer experience, or developer productivity function.
  • Proven success in overseeing all elements of the product development lifecycle, such as user research, design, implementation and evaluation.
  • Speak fluent English
  • Bonus if you:
    • Have proven experience with successfully rolling out AI-based solutions in a larger org
    • Have professional experience in a consumer fintech company

You might be a good fit if you

  • Resonate deeply with how we do product and have experience working that way.
  • Are continuously iterating on using AI in real workflows with honest evaluation.
  • Are a strong communicator who can inspire and lead by influence.
  • Are great at coordinating across teams and excel at communicating across multiple cultures.
  • Take ownership for outcomes and do whatever you can to make them close to inevitable.
  • Have strong instincts for asking questions that could move the needle.
  • Have the courage and persistence to replan when feedback or new information arrives.
  • Always listen with empathy but ruthlessly prioritize based on impact.

About Product at Wave

Product has always been very important to us at Wave, starting from day one with two very strong product-minded founders. Product Managers play a central role in our organization, impacting large chunks of the company around them, similar to the founders they were shaped after years ago.

Our approach to building products may not be what you've seen in other places. Our processes are lightweight, informed by principles instead of methodologies and our PMs don't just manage backlogs full of polished tickets. Read our write-up on product at Wave!

If you're excited to own a real problem end-to-end, set your own goals, and guide a team toward outcomes that matter for real people, you'll feel right at home here.

If that's you, we'd love to meet you.

Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!</p></div><p>We're looking for a technically-minded product designer who is excited to shape how design, code, and AI-powered workflows come together at Figma. In this role, you'll improve how Figma understands production code and design systems, design workflows that move from design to code and back again, and extend Figma's agentic capabilities into developer tools and the places teams already work. understanding of software development workflows, APIs, and systems; experience prototyping and evaluating AI-powered or nondeterministic interactions is a plus</li> </ul> <h4><strong>While it's not title: Senior Business Operations Lead
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><h2><strong>The Community You Will Join</strong></h2> <p>The Chief Business Officer organization drives company-wide growth and global expansion.&nbsp;</p> <p>This is the role that turns Airbnb's ambition for the UKI &amp; Nordics into a plan and holds the organisation to delivering it: shaping strategy, aligning cross-functional teams, and driving sustainable commercial growth across one of our most important regions.</p> <p>This includes recruiting and supporting high-quality Stays, Experiences, and Services, alongside executing Airbnb’s global market strategy. Shaping business approaches, quality supply sourcing, and international growth efforts are integral to the team’s success in connecting millions more hosts and guests to Airbnb's platform.</p> <h2><strong>The Difference You Will Make</strong></h2> <p>You will join the UKI, Nordics, Middle East and Africa team, covering one of Airbnb’s largest and most mature markets alongside five of Europe’s most digitally advanced, high-trust travel markets. The UK offers scale, brand strength, and a sophisticated regulatory environment; the Nordics offer strong domestic travel behaviour and significant headroom for growth. Together they make this one of the most commercially interesting regions in EMEA to build in.</p> <h2><strong>A Typical Day</strong></h2> <p>You will own the business operations agenda for the UKI and Nordics. Airbnb’s most established European market alongside five high-potential Nordic markets (Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland). Partnering closely with the Country Manager, you will set the regional growth strategy, translate it into a plan cross-functional teams can execute against, and run the operating rhythm that keeps it on track. This is a high-visibility role: your influence will come from the quality of your thinking and your ability to mobilise teams to grow further.</p> <h3><strong>Regional growth strategy</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the UKI &amp; Nordics growth strategy end to end: define where the region should compete, what it should stop doing, and the handful of bets that will move guest nights, supply growth, and revenue.</li> <li>Build the annual and quarterly plan with the Country Manager, sizing opportunities and making explicit recommendations on where to deploy marketing spend, supply investment, and partnership effort.</li> <li>Set and pressure-test the region’s targets, translating global goals into market-level commitments that supply, marketing, partnerships, policy, and product teams can own.</li> <li>Run deep-dive analyses on demand and supply dynamics, competitive movements, pricing, and seasonality, turning each into a clear recommendation, not just a read-out.</li> <li>Identify and stand up new growth initiatives, using the UK as a test market for offerings that can then scale across EMEA, and the Nordics as a proving ground for high-penetration, low-friction market plays.</li> <li>Build the case for investment in the region: sizing, business case, and the socialisation needed to win resource in global planning cycles.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Operating rhythm and execution</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the region’s operating cadence: weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews, so leadership has a single, trusted view of performance and the story behind it.</li> <li>Convert strategy into sequenced execution plans with named owners, milestones, and success measures across supply, marketing, partnerships, policy, and product.</li> <li>Track delivery against the plan, surfacing risks and bottlenecks early and driving them to resolution rather than escalating them.</li> <li>Design and continuously improve the operating processes the region runs on, raising the bar on efficiency, transparency, and decision speed.</li> <li>Lead the region’s input into global planning and resource allocation cycles.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Cross-functional leadership</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Act as the connective tissue between the UKI &amp; Nordics team and global functions such as Product, Marketing, Communications, Policy, Finance, Data Science, Legal, and Community Support.</li> <li>Be the go-to decision partner alongside the Country Manager: the person other teams come to for the region’s position, context, and priorities.</li> <li>Build alignment on high-priority projects, market launches, and product tests, brokering trade-offs between global consistency and local market reality.</li> <li>Represent UKI &amp; Nordics in NEMEA and global business operations forums, and bring the best of what other markets are doing back into the region.</li> <li>Partner with Public Policy on the regulatory landscape, including short-term let rules in the UKI and Nordic city regulation so commercial plans account for policy risk and opportunity.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Insights and storytelling</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Turn complex data into clear narratives that help leadership decide with a recommendation attached.</li> <li>Build the reporting layer the region relies on: dashboards, performance packs, and executive materials, working with a dedicated analyst.</li> <li>Establish the metrics that matter for the region and hold the team to a shared definition of success.</li> <li>Champion data-driven decision-making, and use AI tooling to compress the time from question to insight. Automating recurring analysis and reporting so the team spends its time on judgement, not assembly.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Your Expertise</strong></h2> <p>To deliver in this role, Airbnb is seeking candidates with:</p> <ul> <li>12+ years in business operations, strategy, consulting, or commercial leadership, with a track record of owning outcomes in a market or business unit</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to set strategy and drive it through to execution&nbsp;</li> <li>Deep experience influencing without authority across a global matrixed organisation</li> <li>Strong analytical toolkit; comfortable working with finance and data science partners and interrogating the numbers yourself</li> <li>Exceptional written and verbal communication, with executive presence in front of senior leadership</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity, and a strong bias toward action and ownership</li> <li>Practical fluency with AI tools and a view on where they change how a team operates</li> <li>Familiarity with the UKI and/or Nordic markets, or comparable mature-market experience</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Additional</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience in a two-sided marketplace, travel/hospitality, or consumer tech</li> <li>Experience launching or scaling new products or lines of business in-market</li> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>This role will require to be in the London office 3 days per week.&nbsp;</strong></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Our Commitment To Inclusion &amp; Belonging:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;">Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.</span></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-size: 16px;"><strong><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">How We'll Take Care of You:</span></strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 16px;">Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.</span></p></div><div class="title">United Kingdom Annual Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£126,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>£158,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Reasonable Accommodations:</strong> We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>A Note on Recruiting Scams:</strong> Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @<a href="http://airbnb.com">airbnb.com</a> or @<a href="http://ext.airbnb.com">ext.airbnb.com</a> email addresses. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:</p></div><p>You'll be the founding analytics engineer in Finance, shaping our data infrastructure and analytical capabilities during a critical transformation. description: <p><strong>About Tripadvisor&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p>As a <strong>Principal Machine Learning Scientist</strong>, you will be the technical anchor for our core discovery engine. You will lead the machine learning strategy and execution that powers how millions of users search for, discover, and organize their complex travel itineraries. This is a high-impact role bridging the gap between cutting-edge AI research and production-grade engineering, directly influencing multi-objective business outcomes like user engagement, booking conversion, etc.</p> <p>You will tackle complex, ambiguous problems at the intersection of deep multi-task ranking, sequential user modeling, and graph-based travel recommendations. Translate high-level business goals into concrete ML architectures and scalable production systems.</li> <li><strong>Advanced Algorithm Innovation:</strong> Design, prototype, and scale next-generation recommendation and ranking models. Solve complex, non-linear travel journeys by utilizing sequential recommenders, representation learning, and deep multi-objective frameworks.</li> <li><strong>System Architecture &amp; Scalability:</strong> Oversee the deployment of low-latency, high-throughput retrieval and ranking pipelines (e.g., multi-stage retrieval, vector search) capable of processing billions of travel data points (reviews, photos, bookings, user intent) in real-time.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration:</strong> Partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering Leads, and Data Science peers to optimize multi-task business objectives simultaneously. Act as the primary technical authority for ML initiatives within the Trips vertical.</li> <li><strong>Talent Multiplier:</strong> Mentor and coach senior and mid-level ML scientists. Foster a culture of technical excellence, driving best practices for MLOps, rigorous A/B testing, data privacy, and code quality.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Skills &amp; Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Education:</strong> Ph.D. or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a highly quantitative field.</li> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> 8+ years of industry experience developing and deploying large-scale ML models in a production environment, with a proven track record of shipping systems at the scale of millions of active users.</li> <li><strong>Core Technical Expertise:</strong> Deep theoretical and practical knowledge in the following areas:</li> <ul> <li><strong>SOTA Retrieval &amp; Ranking:</strong> Practical experience with Multi-Task Learning (MTL), Multi-gate Mixture-of-Experts (MMoE), or similar architectures optimized for multi-objective optimization.</li> <li><strong>Sequential &amp; Temporal Modeling:</strong> Hands-on experience building sequential recommendation systems that capture real-time user session dynamics and long-term historical preferences.</li> <li><strong>Advanced Representation Learning:</strong> Deep understanding of embedding generation, deep semantic retrieval, and multi-modal representation learning.</li> </ul> <li><strong>Technical Stack:</strong> Mastery of Python and deep learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch) alongside hands-on experience with distributed computing (Spark, Ray) and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP).</li> </ul> <p><em>&nbsp;</em></p> <p><strong>Desired:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Graph Neural Networks (GNNs):</strong> Strong experience applying GNNs, knowledge graphs, or graph embeddings to map complex relations between travel entities (e.g., users, destinations, itineraries, points of interest).</li> <li><strong>Agentic AI &amp; Generative AI:</strong> Familiarity with Agentic AI frameworks, LLM-driven reasoning, or autonomous planning agents to enhance conversational search and automated itinerary generation.</li> <li>Experience working in <strong>E-commerce, Travel Tech, or Two-Sided Marketplaces</strong>, specifically handling non-linear user journeys and highly constrained inventory (e.g., hotel availability, tour timings).</li> <li>A strong track record of academic or industry contributions, including publications in top-tier AI/IR conferences (e.g., SIGIR, KDD, RecSys, NeurIPS) or open-source ML contributions.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What We Offer&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses</li> <li>“Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.</li> <li>Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.</li> <li>Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.</li> <li>Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.</li> <li>Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.</li> <li>Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.</li> <li>Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.</li> <li>Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Our Cultural Pillars:</strong></p> <p><strong>Traveler first</strong></p> <p>We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Execution is our edge</strong></p> <p>We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. It's the platform every person in the company uses and builds on: devices, meeting rooms, core applications, SSO, AI tools, data infrastructure, security and compliance. The Systems & Security (SYSSEC) team builds it, runs it, and keeps improving it. It'll never be finished. That's the point. hxOS is as much a vision as a current reality. The foundations are solid, day to day runs well because it has to, nothing gets built on shaky ground. The more ambitious layers - federated, AI-native, product-led infrastructure that the whole business builds on - are what the team is building now. They're the first point of contact for everything coming into the team, and the work ranges widely: a day might move from troubleshooting a device, to helping a team get more out of a new AI integration, to contributing to a piece of infrastructure the whole company will rely on. How it feels to reach out to SYSSEC starts and ends with how this person shows up. Improve the service, continuously. Good enough today is a problem tomorrow. Look for recurring patterns, find root causes, and change the conditions that created them, through better templates, self-serve paths, proactive communication, and process work that makes repeat tickets rarer over time. Build things that reduce the work. Scripts, automations, integrations, paved-road workflows. Engineer toil out of the system rather than just processing it, and contribute to the broader hxOS integration layer: connectors, routing logic, self-serve tooling that makes the platform more capable over time. Be a partner to the business. As the internal expert in hxOS, help colleagues get more out of their devices, applications, and AI tools. This isn't ticket resolution, it's helping people understand what's possible and removing friction between them and a platform designed to make them better at their jobs. Contribute to strategic delivery. Around 20% of the role is higher-leverage work: contributing to platform design, supporting infrastructure decisions, and building the technical foundations needed to take on bigger challenges over time. What good looks like Reliable under volume. Owns a queue without being chased, keeps work moving and stakeholders informed, and holds the same standard whether it's a routine request or a change that touches critical infrastructure. Builds rather than just processes. Comfortable writing scripts and configuring automations, thinks in repeatable patterns rather than one-off fixes, and treats "make the next version of this job smaller" as the actual goal. Already AI-native, not AI-curious. Uses AI tools as a natural part of everyday work: triage, documentation, automation scaffolding, first-pass review. Has judgement about where it helps and where it doesn't, rather than reaching for it by default. Figures things out unprompted. Given a problem, researches it, tests it, forms a view, and comes back with a recommendation rather than a question. Comfortable with ambiguity, applies feedback fast, and is honest about what they do and don't know yet. Why hx You'll become hxOS's internal expert: the person colleagues turn to when they want to understand what's possible, get more from their tools, or work through something new. It's a rare mix of technical depth, operational credibility, and real visibility at the centre of how the company runs, with a clear path from owning the queue to shaping the platform itself. You're joining a generational business at a real inflection point. hx isn't an early-stage bet. We have nearly 60 of the world's largest insurers as customers, exceptional NRR (genuinely rare) at 125%+, billions in premium flowing through the platform, and backing from a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery. You get the rare combination: a varied craft role with the freedom to build, and the strong backing of a company that's already winning. Benefits £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development. 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total). Company pension scheme via Penfold. Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life . Individual well-being allowance via Juno . Private healthcare insurance through AXA. Income protection and Life Insurance. Cycle to Work Scheme Additional Perks: Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.). Regular hackathons, lunch & learns, and socials, both remote and in-person, to foster collaboration and creativity. Team breakfasts and lunches, fully stocked snacks and drinks, and a fun, creative office at The Ministry . Access to cutting-edge AI tools and experimentation budget, giving you the freedom to test, learn, and innovate ahead of the market. description: Introduction to Role & Team At Bumble, our mission is to create a world where healthy and equitable relationships and friendships thrive, and our Legal team plays an important role in protecting the ideas, brands, technology, and experiences that bring that mission to life. As Lead Legal Counsel within our IP team, you’ll be a senior subject-matter expert helping Bumble navigate complex intellectual property questions across our brands, products, technology, content, and creative work. You’ll independently lead significant IP matters and shape practical strategies in close partnership with colleagues across Legal, Marketing, Creative, Brand, Design, Product, and Engineering, combining Courage and Curiosity with strong commercial judgement. You’ll also help us explore the opportunities and risks created by AI and other emerging technologies, using AI thoughtfully in your own work while applying human judgement, care, and accountability to the outcomes. What You’ll Do Shape and execute Bumble’s global intellectual property strategy in partnership with Legal leadership, translating business, brand, product, and technology priorities into practical approaches to protection, portfolio management, licensing, and enforcement. Take ownership of significant matters across Bumble’s international trademark, copyright, patent, domain name, trade secret, and broader digital asset portfolio, working with external counsel and specialist providers to protect strategically important intellectual property. Collaborate with purpose across Marketing, Creative, Brand, Design, Product, and Engineering, providing practical rights-clearance and IP advice from early concept and development through launch, including trademarks, copyright, publicity rights, creator and talent rights, user-generated content, and third-party materials. Independently lead complex IP enforcement and dispute matters, including infringement, oppositions, litigation support, and evidence management, applying commercial judgement to determine where action can deliver meaningful protection for Bumble’s brands and innovation. Advise on the creation, ownership, protection, licensing, and commercialisation of Bumble-developed intellectual property, and draft and negotiate sophisticated IP arrangements including licences, coexistence agreements, assignments, merchandising arrangements, technology agreements, and strategic partnerships. Partner with Product and Engineering on patent strategy, software development, open-source software, and innovation protection, while advising on emerging IP questions involving generative AI, training data, provenance, ownership, licensing, and infringement risk. Take ownership of IP priorities from insight to impact by supporting due diligence for significant partnerships, investments, and acquisitions and by developing practical playbooks, precedents, training, and self-service guidance that help teams identify and manage IP risk consistently. Champion Bumble’s values of Excellence and Respect by providing clear, pragmatic advice to senior stakeholders and maintaining an agile mindset as legal, technology, and business priorities evolve. Use approved AI tools where appropriate to strengthen legal research, review, summarisation, and knowledge management, while carefully assessing outputs for accuracy, privacy, bias, and responsible use. About You You are qualified as a solicitor in England and Wales, or hold an equivalent qualification in another European jurisdiction. Typically requires 8+ years of experience, though we welcome candidates with alternative backgrounds that demonstrate equivalent skills. You bring deep intellectual property expertise, particularly across trademarks, copyright, brand protection, licensing, portfolio management, rights clearance, and technology-related IP matters, developed in-house, in private practice, or through a combination of both. You have strong experience advising consumer technology or similarly complex businesses on intellectual property issues involving software, digital content, product innovation, AI, and emerging technologies, and can independently develop practical solutions to significant or unusual legal questions. You are an accomplished drafter and negotiator who can manage sophisticated IP and technology arrangements and translate complex legal concepts into clear recommendations that enable informed commercial decisions. You collaborate with purpose and build trusted relationships with senior partners across different disciplines. You take ownership of challenging matters, see work through from insight to impact, and adapt your approach with an agile mindset as priorities and information evolve. You combine sound commercial judgement with strong organisational and project-management skills, distinguishing material business risks from theoretical ones while effectively managing multiple priorities, international portfolios, external advisers, and specialist providers. You demonstrate Curiosity, Courage, and Excellence in how you work, and you are comfortable identifying and using AI opportunities to improve effectiveness and insight while exercising appropriate human judgement and applying AI responsibly, inclusively, and with care for confidentiality and data privacy. At Bumble, our mission is to create a world where healthy and equitable relationships and friendships thrive, and our Legal team plays an important role in protecting the ideas, brands, technology, and experiences that bring that mission to life. As Lead Legal Counsel within our IP team, you’ll be a senior subject-matter expert helping Bumble navigate complex intellectual property questions across our brands, products, technology, content, and creative work. You’ll independently lead significant IP matters and shape practical strategies in close partnership with colleagues across Legal, Marketing, Creative, Brand, Design, Product, and Engineering, combining Courage and Curiosity with strong commercial judgement. You’ll also help us explore the opportunities and risks created by AI and other emerging technologies, using AI thoughtfully in your own work while applying human judgement, care, and accountability to the outcomes.

What You’ll Do

  • Shape and execute Bumble’s global intellectual property strategy in partnership with Legal leadership, translating business, brand, product, and technology priorities into practical approaches to protection, portfolio management, licensing, and enforcement.

  • Take ownership of significant matters across Bumble’s international trademark, copyright, patent, domain name, trade secret, and broader digital asset portfolio, working with external counsel and specialist providers to protect strategically important intellectual property.

  • Collaborate with purpose across Marketing, Creative, Brand, Design, Product, and Engineering, providing practical rights-clearance and IP advice from early concept and development through launch, including trademarks, copyright, publicity rights, creator and talent rights, user-generated content, and third-party materials.

  • Independently lead complex IP enforcement and dispute matters, including infringement, oppositions, litigation support, and evidence management, applying commercial judgement to determine where action can deliver meaningful protection for Bumble’s brands and innovation.

  • Advise on the creation, ownership, protection, licensing, and commercialisation of Bumble-developed intellectual property, and draft and negotiate sophisticated IP arrangements including licences, coexistence agreements, assignments, merchandising arrangements, technology agreements, and strategic partnerships.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering on patent strategy, software development, open-source software, and innovation protection, while advising on emerging IP questions involving generative AI, training data, provenance, ownership, licensing, and infringement risk.

  • Take ownership of IP priorities from insight to impact by supporting due diligence for significant partnerships, investments, and acquisitions and by developing practical playbooks, precedents, training, and self-service guidance that help teams identify and manage IP risk consistently.

  • Champion Bumble’s values of Excellence and Respect by providing clear, pragmatic advice to senior stakeholders and maintaining an agile mindset as legal, technology, and business priorities evolve. Use approved AI tools where appropriate to strengthen legal research, review, summarisation, and knowledge management, while carefully assessing outputs for accuracy, privacy, bias, and responsible use.

 

About You

  • You are qualified as a solicitor in England and Wales, or hold an equivalent qualification in another European jurisdiction.

  • Typically requires 8+ years of experience, though we welcome candidates with alternative backgrounds that demonstrate equivalent skills.

  • You bring deep intellectual property expertise, particularly across trademarks, copyright, brand protection, licensing, portfolio management, rights clearance, and technology-related IP matters, developed in-house, in private practice, or through a combination of both.

  • You have strong experience advising consumer technology or similarly complex businesses on intellectual property issues involving software, digital content, product innovation, AI, and emerging technologies, and can independently develop practical solutions to significant or unusual legal questions.

  • You are an accomplished drafter and negotiator who can manage sophisticated IP and technology arrangements and translate complex legal concepts into clear recommendations that enable informed commercial decisions.

  • You collaborate with purpose and build trusted relationships with senior partners across different disciplines. You take ownership of challenging matters, see work through from insight to impact, and adapt your approach with an agile mindset as priorities and information evolve.

  • You combine sound commercial judgement with strong organisational and project-management skills, distinguishing material business risks from theoretical ones while effectively managing multiple priorities, international portfolios, external advisers, and specialist providers.

  • You demonstrate Curiosity, Courage, and Excellence in how you work, and you are comfortable identifying and using AI opportunities to improve effectiveness and insight while exercising appropriate human judgement and applying AI responsibly, inclusively, and with care for confidentiality and data privacy.

 

Benefits & Perks

  • Annual personal learning & development budget

  • Private Medical Insurance (PMI)

  • Private Dental Insurance

  • Babylon Health app

  • Mental health support

  • Enhanced parental leave, including a highly competitive maternity package

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Subsidised gym membership

  • ‘Double matched’ pension contributions up to 6%

  • Premium App Access

About Us

Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products.

AI Fluency

AI is important to us. We’re excited by people who are curious and experimental, and who think thoughtfully about how AI can amplify their impact and outcomes.

We encourage you to use AI responsibly as you prepare your application. Please don’t use it to fabricate experiences or answer questions live in interviews. Final Compensation

Inclusion at Bumble Inc.

Bumble Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and we strongly encourage people of all ages, color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non-binary people, veterans, parents, people with disabilities, and neurodivergent people to apply. We're happy to make any reasonable adjustments that will help you feel more confident throughout the process, please don't hesitate to let us know how we can help.

We're rapidly growing following our 14x oversubscribed seed round backed by Tier 1 investors including Northzone and Initialized Capital. These funds backed the founders of Coinbase, Reddit, Klarna, and Spotify.

We're growing very fast; demand is outstripping our supply, and we're building fast to keep up.

The Team

Our team includes AI researchers from world-leading academic institutions like Johns Hopkins, MIPT, Oxford, Cambridge and UCL, former founding engineers at unicorn startups, and alumni of X, Google, Amazon, and Yandex, alongside former leaders from McKinsey, BCG and Bain. We look for people who move fast, think clearly, and hold themselves to a high bar. The standard here is very high, and we're looking for someone who raises it further.

The Role

Special Projects sits directly alongside the CEO and Chief of Staff and takes on whatever the company needs most at that moment. There is no fixed remit and there is no playbook.

One month that means preparing the material and the numbers behind a fundraise. The next it's working through legal, regulatory, and market access questions in a country we're entering, or holding an entire function open on your own until we've hired someone permanent into it. Whatever is broken, missing, or unowned lands here first.

Be clear eyed about what this is. It is demanding, and a lot of it is unglamorous. Some of it is detail work that simply has to be right, with nobody available to check it behind you. What we need is a workhorse who is obsessive about detail, who closes things out rather than hands them back, and whose work nobody ever has to second guess. If that reads as a description of you rather than a warning, this is the highest leverage seat in the company for someone early in their career. You will be in the room for decisions most people see five years later.

What We're Looking For

1–3 years in an environment with a high bar and short feedback loops: investment banking, strategy consulting, a fast growing startup, or something equally demanding we haven't thought of.

An exceptional track record: We care that you were at the top of whatever room you were in, academically and professionally.

AI-native: You already run your work through AI and operate at 10x as a result. You reach for these tools by default, not as a novelty, and you're constantly finding new ways to compress what used to take days into hours.

Structured thinking: You break messy, ambiguous problems into parts, work out what actually matters, and sequence it. You can explain your reasoning on a whiteboard in two minutes.

Ruthless organisation: Multiple workstreams, nothing dropped, nothing chased twice, everything written down.

Strong with Excel, slides, and written communication: Most of our work travels as documents and models read by executives at large regulated businesses.

Bias to action: You'd rather ship a good plan today than a perfect one next week.

Work nobody has to check: You close the loop, catch your own mistakes, and flag the things you couldn't resolve rather than leaving them to be discovered.

Low ego, high agency: The work ranges from a board memo to cleaning a customer data set at 9pm. Neither is beneath you, and you'll take on the boring half as readily as the interesting half.

Someone who wants to be in the room, not on a call. This role is in-person, full time at our Shoreditch office.

Nice to have: European languages, particularly German or French.

What You'll Get

A huge amount of responsibility and trust from day one, and direct exposure to every decision that shapes the company

A front row seat to enterprise sales, product, fundraising, and operations, and a real say in all of them

A clear path into an operating or commercial leadership role as we scale or insight into how to start your own tech company some day

A team that moves fast, works hard, and backs each other fully

Lunch and dinner covered, 24/7 gym access

title: Gestionnaire RH & Paie H/F
description: À propos d'Everfield Everfield achète, développe et accompagne la croissance d'éditeurs de logiciels métiers et spécialisés en Europe, en leur donnant les clés pour franchir un cap. Notre mission : nourrir l'ambition, alimenter la croissance et révéler le potentiel de l'écosystème logiciel européen. Les entreprises de l'écosystème Everfield évoluent selon un modèle décentralisé : elles conservent leur équipe, leur marque et leurs bureaux, et se concentrent sur ce qu'elles font de mieux, développer leurs produits et accompagner leurs clients. Everfield les épaule sur le recrutement et les RH, et leur donne accès à une équipe d'experts qui les conseille sur les aspects financiers et opérationnels de la construction et de la croissance des entreprises B2B SaaS européennes. Fondé en 2022, Everfield est déjà présent dans 7 pays, et continue de se développer. Rôle En tant que Gestionnaire RH & Paie, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans le bon fonctionnement des opérations RH au sein des sociétés du portefeuille. En étroite collaboration avec l'équipe HR Business Partnering, vous gérerez l'administration RH, coordonnerez la paie et fournirez des données et rapports précis pour appuyer la prise de décision. Vous serez le premier point de contact pour les questions RH quotidiennes des collaborateurs, en garantissant un support RH rapide, précis et conforme. Ce rôle constitue le socle d'une gestion RH efficace, permettant aux dirigeants et aux HRBP de se concentrer sur les priorités stratégiques. Responsabilités clés (liste non exhaustive) Administration RH : gérer le cycle de vie des collaborateurs, y compris l'intégration, les départs et la gestion des absences. Rédiger et émettre les contrats de travail et leurs avenants, tenir à jour le SIRH, et administrer les avantages sociaux et régimes de retraite de l'entreprise. Paie : préparer, traiter et valider la paie mensuelle des sociétés du portefeuille, en liaison avec le prestataire de paie externe. Garantir l'exactitude et le respect des délais. Opérations RH : être le premier point de contact pour les questions des collaborateurs. Contribuer à la mise à jour des politiques et veiller au respect des exigences légales locales en matière de droit du travail. Conformité : maintenir des dossiers du personnel exacts et à jour. Produire les courriers et modèles liés à l'emploi. Veiller à ce que la documentation soit prête pour un audit et conforme aux exigences légales et internes. Données et reporting : garantir un haut niveau de fiabilité des données dans les systèmes RH. Fournir des données et rapports sur les collaborateurs pour alimenter les tableaux de bord, les analyses et la prise de décision. Support HRBP & CoE : contribuer à la préparation des dossiers d'intégration, de la documentation disciplinaire, des enquêtes de départ, et des tâches RH opérationnelles. Apporter un soutien aux équipes CoE dans le déploiement de programmes. Compétences et expérience requises Expérience préalable en administration RH ou dans un poste RH opérationnel similaire, appréciée. Expérience avec les systèmes RH (Workday souhaité). Excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides capacités d'organisation et souci du détail. Bonne compréhension du droit du travail local et des meilleures pratiques RH, indispensable. Solides compétences en communication pour échanger avec les collaborateurs et parties prenantes à tous les niveaux. Capacité à gérer des informations sensibles avec discrétion et confidentialité. Esprit proactif et orienté solutions, avec la capacité à gérer efficacement plusieurs priorités. Paie France - sécurité sociale et invalidité : expérience confirmée dans la gestion de ces dossiers spécifiques, incluant la relation avec les organismes concernés (CPAM, prévoyance, etc.), le traitement des arrêts maladie, congés maternité et situations d'invalidité sur les bulletins de paie, ainsi que la mise à jour des taux de cotisation lors des révisions annuelles. title: AIT MGSE Engineer - Lunar Lander
description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation. As part of this initiative, we are developing a lunar lander capable of precision landing and reusable operations. To support this effort, we are establishing a dedicated remote test site in the United Arab Emirates to perform hot-fire propulsion testing and hopper flight demonstrations. We want you as a talented AIT MGSE Engineer to help us in our mission by designing and delivering the MGSEs needed for the preparation and testing of our Lunar Lander. Key Responsibilities In your capacity as AIT MGSE Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day duties will include: Work closely with Engineering and AIT colleagues to understand and refine the requirements/timelines for the different MGSEs that we will need for various assembly or testing activities. Conceptualise, design (CAD including manufacturing drawings), procure and commission the MGSEs. Confirm with mechanical analysis/hand calculations/proof tests that the design is compatible with the external loads. Discuss with suppliers the MGSE designs for ease of manufacturing and with the most adequate processes. Follow up the manufacturing/procurement with the suppliers (with the support of our supply chain team) and answer any technical questions/concerns ensuring timely delivery of all items. Provide necessary instructions and support the assembly / commissioning / implementation of these MGSEs. What we would love to see from you In the role of AIT MGSE Engineer ideally, you will have the following: Mechanical / Aerospace engineering degree or similar with focus on machine / structural design. Minimum 2 years of experience in CAD design + drafting (using Siemens NX or similar) and FE analysis (using Hypermesh or similar). raw.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.


As part of this initiative, we are developing a lunar lander capable of precision landing and reusable operations. To support this effort, we are establishing a dedicated remote test site in the United Arab Emirates to perform hot-fire propulsion testing and hopper flight demonstrations.

We want you as a talented AIT MGSE Engineer to help us in our mission by designing and delivering the MGSEs needed for the preparation and testing of our Lunar Lander.

Key Responsibilities

In your capacity as AIT MGSE Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day duties will include:

  • Work closely with Engineering and AIT colleagues to understand and refine the requirements/timelines for the different MGSEs that we will need for various assembly or testing activities.

  • Conceptualise, design (CAD including manufacturing drawings), procure and commission the MGSEs.

  • Confirm with mechanical analysis/hand calculations/proof tests that the design is compatible with the external loads.

  • Discuss with suppliers the MGSE designs for ease of manufacturing and with the most adequate processes.

  • Follow up the manufacturing/procurement with the suppliers (with the support of our supply chain team) and answer any technical questions/concerns ensuring timely delivery of all items.

  • Provide necessary instructions and support the assembly / commissioning / implementation of these MGSEs.

What we would love to see from you

In the role of AIT MGSE Engineer ideally, you will have the following:

  • Mechanical / Aerospace engineering degree or similar with focus on machine / structural design.

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in CAD design + drafting (using Siemens NX or similar) and FE analysis (using Hypermesh or similar).

  • Good understanding of machine design and different manufacturing processes (e.g. machining, welding, etc), design for manufacturing and GD&T.

  • Familiarity with standard margin calculation methodologies for various applications like beam design, bolted joints, welds, etc.
