description: Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ? Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance. Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière. Notre vision Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes. Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise. Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. À propos de Pennylane Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à : 💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant 💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches! 🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible 🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France ! Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ? Afin d’accompagner notre croissance et répondre à nos enjeux 2026, nous ouvrons un nouveau poste au sein de l’équipe Sales en charge de la relation avec les clients SMEs des cabinets comptables partenaires de Pennylane. Tu auras un rôle central en étant le point de contact privilégié des cabinets comptables souhaitant déployer Pennylane chez leurs clients En effet, depuis 1 an, nous accélérons fortement dans l’acquisition de nouveaux cabinets comptables. L’outil Pennylane prenant tout son sens lorsque les Experts Comptables et leurs clients travaillent ensemble dessus, c’est dans leur intérêt d’équiper au maximum leurs clients. Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ? En échangeant avec les cabinets comptables partenaires pour identifier les SMEs de leurs portefeuilles les plus à même de pouvoir s’équiper de Pennylane. En mettant en place des actions commerciales terrains (évènements physiques, webinaires, journée portes ouvertes) afin de faire connaître Pennylane auprès des SMEs de nos cabinets comptables partenaires. En gérant de l’ensemble du cycle de vente de Pennylane sur ces SMEs (Qualification, Démo, Closing). Tu travailleras main dans la main avec: Les Account Executives Cabinets Comptables : ils sont en charge de vendre Pennylane à un maximum de cabinets comptables. Les Account Managers : ils gèrent la relation commerciale avec le cabinet comptable et la coordination des projets de monétisation des SMEs avec nos cabinets comptables partenaires. A quoi ressembleront tes débuts chez nous? 3 premiers mois : Tu apprends à connaître Pennylane, sa vision, ses équipes afin de t'y sentir pleinement intégré Tu intègres la sales academy afin de connaître parfaitement le rôle de chacun et de saisir le fonctionnement de l'équipe sales au global Tu es formé par ton manager afin de prendre tes marques au sein de l'équipe Tu montes en compétences sur l’outil Tu prends en main tes prospects, accompagné par ton manger Tu deviens autonome sur des ventes simples 4 à 8 mois Tu gères en autonomie tes premières ventes complexes Tu traites des leads de plus en plus complexes et stratégiques pour l'entreprise Tu participes aux améliorations des process au sein de l'équipe et partage tes bonnes pratiques Tu collabores avec les autres équipes de Pennylane (customer care, produit, sales...) afin de transmettre tes retours clients et participer à l'amélioration continue de notre plateforme Et ensuite... : Tu deviens un(e) AE confirmé (et donc un expert du produit), et tu es capable de gérer n'importe quel type de lead Tu es owner d'un ou de plusieurs side project.s Tu contribues activement à la mise à jour des process dans notre base interne (Notion) Tu participes au mentoring et à la formation des nouveaux arrivants dans l'équipe Process de recrutement - Un premier entretien avec Orane : Senior Business Recruiter (30 min) - Un deuxième entretien de fit avec Stan, Manager de l’équipe (45 min) - Une mise en situation + case study avec Stan, Manager de l’équipe et un membre de l'équipe (1h) - Un Final Round avec Jacob, Head of Sales SMEs (45 min) - Un Team Fit Interview avec les membres de l'équipe (45 min) - sur site 🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir : 🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind) 🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile) 🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés 🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu 🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking 🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris 💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE 🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib 💻 Un Mac 🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous. Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra: Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules) Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne. Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères. Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable ! Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges. Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires). Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @ pennylane.com ou ----- . Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement. Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement ." Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps. 🇫🇷 Données personnelles Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à : Notre data policy 🇬🇧 Personal Data Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more 🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren 🇪🇸 Datos personales Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. title: Clinical Data Manager RWD/RWE
description: À propos de Lifen Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales peuvent transformer le système de santé, à condition qu’elles soient accessibles. Mieux les faire circuler, c’est réduire la charge administrative, mieux coordonner les soins et accélérer la recherche clinique. Depuis 2015, nous développons des solutions qui aident les professionnels de santé à partager les informations médicales et les chercheurs à exploiter des données de santé. Plus de 150 personnes travaillent chez Lifen, depuis nos bureaux et à distance. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé en France. Notre équipe L’équipe Clinical Ops intervient au cœur de nos projets de recherche clinique fondés sur des données de santé. Elle transforme des documents médicaux en données structurées, nécessaires à la constitution de cohortes patients et à la préparation des exports utilisés dans nos projets de recherche. Aujourd’hui, l’équipe structure environ 100 à 200 cas patients par semaine . Notre ambition : tripler cette capacité dans les 9 prochains mois, tout en maintenant un haut niveau de qualité des données. Pour y parvenir, nous cherchons une personne capable de reprendre le management de l’équipe, mais surtout de piloter le flux de production, d’anticiper la charge et de porter une démarche d’amélioration continue avec les équipes Produit, IA et Engineering. C’est un rôle à la croisée du management opérationnel, de la RWD et de l’amélioration de processus . Ce que tu feras chez nous Ta première mission sera de reprendre le pilotage de la production des cohortes afin d’en améliorer simultanément la qualité, la capacité de traitement et le niveau d’automatisation . Concrètement, tu seras amené·e à : Manager et faire grandir l’équipe Clinical Ops, en donnant un cadre clair aux priorités et en organisant l’activité quotidienne. Anticiper la charge et piloter la capacité de production afin de limiter les bottlenecks et de mieux absorber les variations de volume. Construire les outils de pilotage nécessaires pour avoir une vision fine du flux : volumes de patients, capacité de traitement, taux d’erreur, points de blocage et charge de l’équipe. Construire et orchestrer une roadmap d’amélioration continue permettant progressivement d’augmenter la capacité de traitement. Porter cette roadmap auprès des équipes Produit, IA et Engineering : rendre les besoins opérationnels visibles, suivre les livrables R&D et créer le rythme nécessaire pour que les améliorations soient effectivement délivrées. Garantir la qualité des cohortes et contribuer à la préparation des exports de données nécessaires aux projets de recherche. Ce que nous attendrons de toi Dans les premiers mois, nous attendrons de toi que tu développes une compréhension très fine du flux Clinical Ops : où se trouvent les blocages, comment évolue la charge et quels leviers permettent réellement d'améliorer la production. Ton succès se mesurera notamment à ta capacité à mettre en place un pilotage fiable de l’activité, à réduire les erreurs et les bottlenecks et à créer, avec les équipes Produit et R&D, un rythme d’amélioration continue suffisamment soutenu pour accompagner notre changement d’échelle. À horizon 9 mois, l’objectif est clair : passer d’environ 100–200 à 300–600 cas patients structurés par semaine, sans multiplier les ressources par trois. Ce que nous recherchons Must-have Nous chercherons en priorité trois éléments dans ton parcours : Une expérience réussie en startup ou scale-up , dans un environnement où les process, outils et responsabilités restaient à construire. Une expérience concrète de la Real-World Data / Real-World Evidence , idéalement autour de la constitution ou de l'exploitation de cohortes patients. Un background santé ou scientifique te permettant de comprendre les enjeux liés aux données médicales et à la recherche clinique. Nous attendons également : Une expérience confirmée de management d’équipe opérationnelle . Une expérience de structuration et de pilotage d’une activité complexe à partir de données et de KPI. Une capacité à passer d’un problème opérationnel très concret à un plan d’amélioration structuré. Une expérience de collaboration étroite avec des équipes Produit, Data/IA ou Engineering . Une capacité à faire avancer une roadmap transverse et à créer de l’accountability autour des livrables. Nice-to-have Un parcours en data management, biostatistiques, épidémiologie ou dans un domaine scientifique proche. Une expérience de structuration de registres, bases de données de santé ou cohortes RWD. Une familiarité avec les enjeux de recherche clinique et les interactions avec les autorités de santé. Une bonne compréhension des usages de l’IA et de l’ingénierie appliqués aux données de santé. Ta manière de travailler Tu as une vraie “just do it mentality” : face à un problème imparfaitement cadré, tu commences par comprendre les faits, tu structures le problème et tu mets rapidement en place les premières solutions. Tu es particulièrement à l’aise dans les environnements où il faut créer les outils plutôt que simplement les utiliser. Si le dashboard dont tu as besoin pour piloter ton équipe n’existe pas, tu es capable de le définir et de le mettre en place. Tu es structuré·e et organisé·e, mais pas bureaucratique. Tu sais entrer suffisamment dans le détail du flux pour comprendre les problèmes réels, tout en gardant une vision d’ensemble et en priorisant ce qui aura le plus d’impact. Enfin, tu sais faire avancer des équipes sur lesquelles tu n’as pas nécessairement d’autorité hiérarchique. Tu rends les problèmes visibles, explicites les priorités et crées le rythme nécessaire pour transformer les décisions en améliorations concrètes. Nos valeurs Embrace Complexity — Tu aimes comprendre un flux de données complexe, en identifier les points de rupture et transformer cette complexité en décisions concrètes. Bienveillance — Tu accompagnes une équipe au quotidien avec exigence, écoute et clarté. Real Impact — Tu améliores la qualité et la disponibilité des données qui permettent de faire avancer des projets de recherche clinique. Process de recrutement Échange de préqualification avec Laura, Talent Acquisition Manager, 30 minutes. Nous faisons connaissance, revenons sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les grandes lignes du poste. C’est aussi le moment de répondre à tes premières questions sur Lifen, l’équipe et le contexte. Entretien avec le VP Reasearch, 60 minutes. Nous revenons plus en détail sur ton parcours, ton expérience en RWD et en constitution de cohortes, ainsi que sur ton expérience de management et de pilotage d’activités opérationnelles. L’objectif est aussi de comprendre la manière dont tu structures et fais évoluer une organisation dans un environnement en croissance. Use Case avec des membres des équipes Clinical Ops et Produit, 60 minutes. À partir de situations concrètes, nous échangeons sur ta manière de structurer une cohorte RWD, d’analyser des problématiques opérationnelles et de construire des plans d’amélioration. Ce sera également l’occasion d’aborder la manière dont tu gères les enjeux humains et la collaboration avec des équipes transverses. Cultural alignment avec deux membres de Lifen, 45 minutes en visio. Ce temps permettra d’échanger sur ta façon de travailler, ton niveau d’autonomie, la collaboration au quotidien et l’adéquation avec nos valeurs. description: Akur8 is a fast-growing InsurTech scale-up on a mission to modernize how insurers assess, price, and manage risk. Our next-generation SaaS platform combines transparent machine learning, predictive analytics, and smart product design to turn complex insurance workflows into scalable, data-driven systems. Powered by expert engineering, data, product, and actuarial teams, Akur8 enables insurers to model risk up to 10x faster while maintaining transparency, explainability, and regulatory trust. As our product suite expands, we are building an end-to-end platform supporting pricing, reserving, and forward-looking risk decisions — helping insurers operate efficiently in a complex environment. We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer, fostering an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives help shape better products and decisions. As Akur8 continues to grow, we are looking for a Business Development Representative Intern to support our Sales team in identifying relevant prospects and creating new conversations with insurance professionals. You will join an international Sales team focused on growing Akur8’s client base through new business, account development, and long-term relationships. You will work closely with Sales Directors, Sales Executives Marketing, Sales Operations, and our Actuarial experts. This internship will give you practical experience in B2B SaaS sales, prospecting, and the insurance technology market. Your mission will include, but not be limited to, the following: PROSPECT RESEARCH • Identify insurance companies, reinsurers, brokers, and other relevant organisations that may benefit from Akur8’s solutions. • Research target accounts, their business priorities, and the people involved in pricing, reserving, actuarial, data, and innovation projects. • Build and maintain clear account lists to support focused outreach. OUTBOUND BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT • Write personalised email and LinkedIn messages that speak to each prospect’s role and business context. • Support outbound calling and follow-up campaigns with guidance from experienced sales colleagues. • Test different messages, channels, and approaches, then share what you learn with the team. LEAD QUALIFICATION AND HANDOFF • Engage with prospects to understand their current processes, challenges, priorities, and potential timelines. • Qualify early conversations against agreed criteria and identify relevant next steps. • Schedule meetings for Account Executives and prepare clear handover notes so that each conversation starts with useful context. SALES AND MARKETING COLLABORATION • Work with Marketing on campaigns, webinars, events, and content aimed at insurance professionals. • Share feedback from prospects to help improve messaging and campaign targeting. • Support the Sales team with account mapping, event preparation, and follow-up activities. • Support the preparation of client-facing slides and materials, review documents created by the team, and adapt content to address specific client needs. CRM AND REPORTING • Keep prospect and activity information accurate in the CRM. • Track outreach, responses, meetings, and follow-up actions. • Prepare simple activity reports and contribute ideas to improve the team’s day-to-day sales process. You will be based in Paris and will work primarily from our office. Occasional travel may be required for team meetings, events, or conferences. We are looking for someone who is curious about business, comfortable speaking with new people, and ready to learn through practice. EDUCATIONAL / PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE • You are currently enrolled in a Business School, university, or equivalent programme and are looking for a full-time 6-month internship, with a starting date between October and December. • You are interested in B2B sales, technology, insurance, or a role that combines business conversations with analytical thinking. • You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, and you are comfortable adapting your message to different audiences. • You are organized, persistent, and able to manage several follow-up tasks without losing track of details. • You take initiative, ask thoughtful questions, and respond well to feedback. • You enjoy working with colleagues from different countries and functions. • You have strong spoken and written English & French. Additional language is a bonus. BONUS SKILLS / EXPERIENCE • A first experience in sales, business development, customer service, or another role involving outreach. • Familiarity with a CRM, sales engagement platform, LinkedIn, or other tools used to research and contact prospects. • Previous experience in an international company, student association, start-up, or technology environment. • An interest in the insurance industry and in the way data can support better business decisions. As a newcomer, you'll be joining a diverse, highly skilled and motivated team, with a strong Tech DNA, colleagues that are eager to share their knowledge and passion. We care about strong teamwork and a positive day-to-day environment. Our software helps retail teams build stronger customer relationships through thoughtful, intuitive technology. From clienteling and customer capture to appointments and in-store experiences, Endear gives brands the tools they need to create more personal interactions and drive measurable growth. We work with brands like Allbirds, Reformation, and Alo Yoga, and we’re continuing to evolve Endear into an increasingly AI-first product built around how modern retail teams actually work. Position Overview We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our IRL (in real life) team, which owns the in-store side of Endear — including appointments, events, customer check-ins, and the administrative experiences behind those workflows. You’ll design for store associates and managers running clienteling day to day, as well as admin users who help shape how those teams operate and manage their workflows. This role is well suited for someone comfortable creating clarity when the solution isn’t obvious. Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early in the process Use customer insight and data to inform design decisions and iteration In your first year, you’ll… Build deeper learning Strengthen your collaboration across Design, Product, and Engineering Demonstrate clear user and business impact through the work you ship You’ll Thrive in This Role If… You enjoy taking ownership of a feature while collaborating closely on the broader vision and direction You’re comfortable with ambiguity and zero-to-one product work You naturally think beyond the happy path and account for edge cases and complete product states You care about creating accessible experiences and solving the right problem, not just creating polished UI You enjoy working closely with Product and Engineering throughout the design process You’re comfortable using research, data, and customer feedback to guide decisions You move quickly, seek feedback, and iterate based on what you learn You’re curious about designing for AI You Have Experience With 2–5 years working in product design Independently owning features from discovery through implementation, with support on vision and direction Running user research from discovery through usability testing Translating broad or ambiguous problems into clear product solutions Working closely with Design, Product, and Engineering teams Designing complex, accessible workflows and accounting for loading, empty, error, and permission states Using qualitative and quantitative data to inform design decisions Building within established design patterns while knowing when something needs to evolve Using AI tools as part of your workflow and applying judgment to AI-generated output A portfolio that demonstrates strong product thinking and execution, and where you can articulate the impact of your work, with data where you had access to it Align With What We Value At Endear, we live by five core principles. Here’s how they translate into what we’re looking for in this role: Customer First: You start by understanding the people using the product, run thoughtful research, and use what you learn to shape better experiences. Take Ownership: You take responsibility for your features, follow through on the details, and care about the quality of what ships. Enable Autonomy: You communicate clearly, collaborate early, and give Product and Engineering the context they need to make strong decisions together. Under Promise, Over Deliver: You set realistic expectations, think through the details, and deliver complete, production-ready work. Innovate & Deliver Value Quickly: You’re comfortable experimenting, using AI and other tools thoughtfully, and moving quickly without sacrificing sound product judgment. About the Team Endear’s product organization is structured across three product teams: AI, IRL, and Core Flows, with one designer dedicated to each. As the IRL designer, you’ll work closely with a Product Manager and 2–3 Engineers while also being part of Endear’s three-person design team. You’ll report to the Head of Product Design, who will provide vision, direction, mentorship, and support as you grow in the role. You’ll partner most closely with: Head of Product Design: vision, direction, mentorship, feedback, and design leadership Product Team: roadmap alignment, priorities, customer needs, and business context Engineering Team: feasibility, implementation, and iteration You’ll have access to mentorship, an education budget, and support around Endear’s AI processes to help you continue developing your craft and expanding how you use AI in your work. We’re a small team with big ambitions — collaborative, customer-obsessed, and deeply excited about the problems we’re solving in retail. Our full team comes together for an all-team standup every Monday at 8:00 AM Pacific, so you’ll need to be available at that time. Apply Even If You Don’t Check Every Box If this role excites you but you’re unsure if you meet every requirement, reach out anyway. No retail or e-commerce background is required. Location: Remote, US-based
Team: Product & Design — IRL
Type: Full-Time, Employee
Compensation: $100K–$129K base
Target Start: January 2027 or earlier

Our Story

At Endear, we’re building the modern CRM for retail teams — starting with the frontline.

Our software helps retail teams build stronger customer relationships through thoughtful, intuitive technology. From clienteling and customer capture to appointments and in-store experiences, Endear gives brands the tools they need to create more personal interactions and drive measurable growth.

We work with brands like Allbirds, Reformation, and Alo Yoga, and we’re continuing to evolve Endear into an increasingly AI-first product built around how modern retail teams actually work.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our IRL (in real life) team, which owns the in-store side of Endear — including appointments, events, customer check-ins, and the administrative experiences behind those workflows.

You’ll design for store associates and managers running clienteling day to day, as well as admin users who help shape how those teams operate and manage their workflows.

In this role, you’ll own features and projects from understanding the problem through research, testing, iteration, and production-ready design, while partnering closely with our Head of Product Design on vision and direction.

The IRL roadmap is early. Many of these features don’t exist yet, so you’ll be defining problems through research before designing solutions.

This role is well suited for someone comfortable creating clarity when the solution isn’t obvious.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 6 months, you’ll…

  • Take ownership of IRL features from discovery through production-ready design

  • Build a strong understanding of how store associates, managers, and admin users work within Endear

  • Run research from early discovery through usability testing

  • Design complete, accessible product experiences, including loading, empty, error, permission, and other key states.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early in the process

  • Use customer insight and data to inform design decisions and iteration

In your first year, you’ll…

  • Build deeper ownership across the IRL product

  • Deliver product experiences that improve how retail teams manage clienteling and in-store workflows

  • Build a strong rhythm of discovery, testing, and continuous learning

  • Strengthen your collaboration across Design, Product, and Engineering

  • Demonstrate clear user and business impact through the work you ship

You’ll Thrive in This Role If…

  • You enjoy taking ownership of a feature while collaborating closely on the broader vision and direction

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity and zero-to-one product work

  • You naturally think beyond the happy path and account for edge cases and complete product states

  • You care about creating accessible experiences and solving the right problem, not just creating polished UI

  • You enjoy working closely with Product and Engineering throughout the design process

  • You’re comfortable using research, data, and customer feedback to guide decisions

  • You move quickly, seek feedback, and iterate based on what you learn

  • You’re curious about designing for AI

You Have Experience With

  • 2–5 years working in product design

  • Independently owning features from discovery through implementation, with support on vision and direction

  • Running user research from discovery through usability testing

raw.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Marketplace
raw.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Mirakl Connect Engineering team lead by Jean-Yves Cazac, Engineering Director. The team consists of approximately 50 engineers covering the full Mirakl Connect product scope, from seller onboarding and experience to marketplace integrations and channel management. Together, you'll be shaping how sellers and brands connect, operate, and grow across multiple marketplaces worldwide.

In this role, you will directly lead 2 squads — Seller Experience and Channel Integration — representing approximately 12 engineers based between Paris, & Bordeaux, with close collaboration with colleagues based in the US.

Location: Based in Paris or Bordeaux office with one day of remote work per week.

 

Your Impact

  • Lead and develop two engineering squads responsible for the seller journey on Mirakl Connect and integrations with external marketplaces such as Amazon, Walmart, and Zalando, ensuring reliable delivery and a high engineering bar across both teams.
  • Partner closely with Product and Design to define priorities, translate business needs into execution plans, and make trade-offs that balance delivery speed, quality, and technical sustainability.
  • Drive the technical direction of your scope — challenging architectural choices, ensuring solutions are scalable and maintainable, and raising best practices in testing, observability, and incident management.
  • Develop your people: coach engineers and tech leads, identify growth opportunities, run performance and career conversations, and contribute to attracting strong talent into the organization.
  • Build a strong operating model for your teams — improving ways of working pragmatically, protecting team focus, fostering ownership, and enabling effective collaboration with distributed and international stakeholders.

 

What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:

  • At least 4 to 5 years of experience managing engineering teams, with a track record of leading teams of 5 to 6 engineers or more, ideally across multiple squads.
  • Proven experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, channel management, feed management, catalog or order management — or a closely related domain.
  • A solid Java background — you may no longer be hands-on today, but you have the depth to challenge architectural decisions, assess technical trade-offs, and manage a team of Java engineers with credibility.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver in a demanding and fast-moving environment, while protecting team focus and adapting your management approach to the existing context.
  • Experience collaborating with international and cross-functional stakeholders across time zones.

Skills:

  • Engineering leadership: ability to set direction, delegate effectively, and develop people at all levels.
  • Execution in complexity: capable of managing delivery, priorities, and trade-offs across multiple teams simultaneously.
  • Technical judgment: able to engage in Java architecture discussions, challenge integration design choices, and guide engineers on complex distributed systems.
  • Fluent English: able to lead discussions, challenge decisions, and collaborate autonomously with US-based and international partners.

 

Tech Stack

  • Java (recent versions)
  • Spring Framework
  • SQL
  • Cloud platforms
  • Microservices architecture

 

Languages

  • French: Full professional proficiency
  • English mandatory: Full professional proficiency — approximately 50% of your working time will be in English

 

Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.
Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

  1. 30/45 min call with a Talent Acquisition to discuss your key projects, ask technical questions, and present the position in details
  2. 1 hour Hiring Manager interview 
  3. 2x45 min STAR interviews to assess your alignment with our values and meet other stakeholders

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. raw.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Multichannel Commerce
raw.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Mirakl Connect Engineering team lead by Jean-Yves Cazac, Engineering Director. The team consists of approximately 50 engineers covering the full Mirakl Connect product scope, from seller onboarding and experience to marketplace integrations and channel management. Together, you'll be shaping how sellers and brands connect, operate, and grow across multiple marketplaces worldwide.

In this role, you will directly lead 2 squads — Seller Experience and Channel Integration — representing approximately 12 engineers based between Paris, & Bordeaux, with close collaboration with colleagues based in the US.

Location: Based in Paris or Bordeaux office with one day of remote work per week.

 

Your Impact

  • Lead and develop two engineering squads responsible for the seller journey on Mirakl Connect and integrations with external marketplaces such as Amazon, Walmart, and Zalando, ensuring reliable delivery and a high engineering bar across both teams.
  • Partner closely with Product and Design to define priorities, translate business needs into execution plans, and make trade-offs that balance delivery speed, quality, and technical sustainability.
  • Drive the technical direction of your scope — challenging architectural choices, ensuring solutions are scalable and maintainable, and raising best practices in testing, observability, and incident management.
  • Develop your people: coach engineers and tech leads, identify growth opportunities, run performance and career conversations, and contribute to attracting strong talent into the organization.
  • Build a strong operating model for your teams — improving ways of working pragmatically, protecting team focus, fostering ownership, and enabling effective collaboration with distributed and international stakeholders.

 

What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:

  • At least 4 to 5 years of experience managing engineering teams, with a track record of leading teams of 5 to 6 engineers or more, ideally across multiple squads.
  • Proven experience in e-commerce, marketplaces, channel management, feed management, catalog or order management — or a closely related domain.
  • A solid Java background — you may no longer be hands-on today, but you have the depth to challenge architectural decisions, assess technical trade-offs, and manage a team of Java engineers with credibility.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver in a demanding and fast-moving environment, while protecting team focus and adapting your management approach to the existing context.
  • Experience collaborating with international and cross-functional stakeholders across time zones.

Skills:

  • Engineering leadership: ability to set direction, delegate effectively, and develop people at all levels.
  • Execution in complexity: capable of managing delivery, priorities, and trade-offs across multiple teams simultaneously.
  • Technical judgment: able to engage in Java architecture discussions, challenge integration design choices, and guide engineers on complex distributed systems.
  • Fluent English: able to lead discussions, challenge decisions, and collaborate autonomously with US-based and international partners.

 

Tech Stack

  • Java (recent versions)
  • Spring Framework
  • SQL
  • Cloud platforms
  • Microservices architecture

 

Languages

  • French: Full professional proficiency
  • English mandatory: Full professional proficiency — approximately 50% of your working time will be in English

 

Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.
Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

  1. 30/45 min call with a Talent Acquisition to discuss your key projects, ask technical questions, and present the position in details
  2. 1 hour Hiring Manager interview 
  3. 2x45 min STAR interviews to assess your alignment with our values and meet other stakeholders

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

title: Chief of staff/GTM to Raphaël Vullierme (Hexa Partner)
description: About Hexa Hexa (formerly eFounders) gives entrepreneurs the best chances to build outstanding companies. We are a pioneering, world-leading startup studio born in Europe that designs, builds and launches category-defining startups. We are today recognized as one of the best venture studios in the world, with a track record comparable to tier-1 VC funds. We have created 60+ companies (including 3 unicorns) with a combined valuation of over $5 billion, among them Aircall, Spendesk, Front, Swan and Yousign. We are passionate about B2B software, particularly AI-native and agentic SaaS, fintech, climate tech, etc. Hexa is in full growth mode, with three early-stage activities: our Ventures programs Hexa Start and Hexa Sprint which help entrepreneurs go from zero to one, and a PE program, Hexa Scale, which takes majority stakes in existing startups and pushes them to new thresholds. The AI-native vertical at Hexa: WTF WTF (“Walk The Frontier”) is leading Hexa’s effort at the frontier of AI model and led by Raphaël Vullierme, a repeat founder who built Luko France #1 online home insurer now part of Allianz, previous CEO of OpenJet an uber for private aviation, and started out launching ventures at Rocket Internet. We build companies with Europe’s best founders, global from day zero, with offices in Paris and San Francisco. We’re building across three theses: Physical AI / Defense / Infrastructure to answer European sovereignty need. This means we are building real technology with very fast time to market and value by moving atoms and not only bits. AI is the buyer. Buying decision are being taken by Agent or from an AI analysis. AI process more data and is less irrational / emotional than human. Cost to compare, switch, quote is trending to 0. This will have an enormous impact on market, what get sold or buy way beyond retail and ecommerce. This will much more transformative to the economy than the efficiency gains most AI startup currently focus on. Financial Services & Regulated business. Raphael was CEO of a full stack & regulated insurer. AI is eating the moat of large Financial institution and we are working to re-invent risk and capital is being moved and allocated. We started in Jan 26 and so far WTF has had a very prolific year building 3 companies. The 2 first raised large seed 4 from TopTier VC 4month after the inception in 2 very different vertical. WaniWani Agentic Commerce Infrastructure for financial services. Leading Banks, Insurers such as Chubb, Satender, BPI, Axa, Generali runs their AI distribution (selling insurance/mortgage to AI agent - on chatGPT/Gemini…) on Waniwani platform. Several million in ARR reach on Year 1 with US being fastest growing market. Pelagon is building a foundational acoustic AI model for autonomous maritime protection, deployed across a distributed network of underwater and surface vectors to give European navies real-time understanding of underwater threats. Working with several EU navies and deployed commercially. It is a rare role to build category-defining companies learn how they get built, from the inside, at the frontier of AI. High intensity team, high challenge, high worker and learned. The mission We’re looking for a Chief of Staff to be the execution backbone of WTF: right hand to Raphaël and to our founders, bringing an operator’s rigor to fast-moving, still-forming teams. The role splits into two: 80% - real company-building Hands-on helping our founders operate their companies across the whole lifecycle, from early discovery and scoping a new idea, through founder search, to building and scaling once it’s live. Go-to-market, your main focus: you own GTM for each company: positioning, first customers, sales, pricing, go-to-market experiments, and the tools, automations and trackers needed to run them. Hexa’s central pool covers product and design; GTM sits with you. You are part of the company and our growth depend on you. In the operational rhythm of each company: weekly kick-offs, product meetings, end-of-week recaps. You own the cadence, objectives set, notes written, decisions tracked, and leverage AI so we focus our time on building and selling not writing down plans. The founders’ first port of call on anything outside their own scope, and the interface between the ventures and the rest of Hexa (Finance, Legal, Talent, Comms), pulling in the right resource when a project needs it. 20% - studio operations How we run as a studio: keeping the machine sharp and the founder pipeline full. About Hexa

Hexa (formerly eFounders) gives entrepreneurs the best chances to build outstanding companies.

We are a pioneering, world-leading startup studio born in Europe that designs, builds and launches category-defining startups. We are today recognized as one of the best venture studios in the world, with a track record comparable to tier-1 VC funds.

We have created 60+ companies (including 3 unicorns) with a combined valuation of over $5 billion, among them Aircall, Spendesk, Front, Swan and Yousign. We are passionate about B2B software, particularly AI-native and agentic SaaS, fintech, climate tech, etc.

Hexa is in full growth mode, with three early-stage activities: our Ventures programs Hexa Start and Hexa Sprint which help entrepreneurs go from zero to one, and a PE program, Hexa Scale, which takes majority stakes in existing startups and pushes them to new thresholds.


The AI-native vertical at Hexa: WTF

WTF (“Walk The Frontier”) is leading Hexa’s effort at the frontier of AI model and led by Raphaël Vullierme, a repeat founder who built Luko France #1 online home insurer now part of Allianz, previous CEO of OpenJet an uber for private aviation, and started out launching ventures at Rocket Internet. We build companies with Europe’s best founders, global from day zero, with offices in Paris and San Francisco.

We’re building across three theses:

  1. Physical AI / Defense / Infrastructure to answer European sovereignty need.
    This means we are building real technology with very fast time to market and value by moving atoms and not only bits.

  2. AI is the buyer.
    Buying decision are being taken by Agent or from an AI analysis. AI process more data and is less irrational / emotional than human. Cost to compare, switch, quote is trending to 0. This will have an enormous impact on market, what get sold or buy way beyond retail and ecommerce. This will much more transformative to the economy than the efficiency gains most AI startup currently focus on.

  3. Financial Services & Regulated business.
    Raphael was CEO of a full stack & regulated insurer. AI is eating the moat of large Financial institution and we are working to re-invent risk and capital is being moved and allocated.

We started in Jan 26 and so far WTF has had a very prolific year building 3 companies. The 2 first raised large seed 4 from TopTier VC 4month after the inception in 2 very different vertical.

  • WaniWani Agentic Commerce Infrastructure for financial services. Leading Banks, Insurers such as Chubb, Satender, BPI, Axa, Generali runs their AI distribution (selling insurance/mortgage to AI agent - on chatGPT/Gemini…) on Waniwani platform. Several million in ARR reach on Year 1 with US being fastest growing market.

  • Pelagon is building a foundational acoustic AI model for autonomous maritime protection, deployed across a distributed network of underwater and surface vectors to give European navies real-time understanding of underwater threats. Working with several EU navies and deployed commercially.

We’re looking for a Chief of Staff to be the execution backbone of WTF: right hand to Raphaël and to our founders, bringing an operator’s rigor to fast-moving, still-forming teams. The role splits into two:

80% - real company-building

Hands-on helping our founders operate their companies across the whole lifecycle, from early discovery and scoping a new idea, through founder search, to building and scaling once it’s live.

title: CENTRALE LYON - Postdoctoral Researcher Position Deep Learning for Functional-Oxide Growth Video-to-Spectrum Prediction by RHEED / XRD Fusion
description: PROJECT OVERVIEW We are looking for a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to develop innovative deeplearning models that predict the structure of functional-oxide thin films directly from their growth dynamics. Positioned at the interface between Artificial Intelligence and materials physics, the OXYD-IA project aims to design a deep model able to predict the final X-ray Diffraction (XRD) spectrum of an oxide thin film from the sole Reflection High-Energy Electron Diffraction (RHEED) video recorded during its growth by Molecular Beam Epitaxy (MBE). The resulting tool will open the way to predictive, in situ control of oxide epitaxy – a process today dominated by a costly trial-and-error approach, in which the structural and functional properties of the films are only validated ex situ. You will join a genuinely multidisciplinary collaboration between the INL (Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon), which provides the operando experimental data and materials-physics expertise, and the LIRIS (équipe Imagine), which provides the deep video-learning and probabilistic-modelling methodology – both at École Centrale de Lyon. A high-impact opportunity. AI for experimental physics is a fast-growing field, and OXYD-IA offers a genuine first-mover advantage within it: you would work on a unique, unpublished dataset of paired RHEED videos and XRD spectra to build one of the first video-to-spectrum models with calibrated uncertainty for oxide growth. By learning directly from experimental 1 data, such a model can short-circuit the traditional trial-and-error loop, accelerate discovery and drastically cut experimental time, cost, precursor consumption and instrument occupancy – turning routine in situ diagnostics into predictive tools. Scientific context. Epitaxial perovskite-oxide thin films exhibit rich, tunable functional properties (thermoelectricity, ferroelectricity, piezoelectricity) governed by their structure and composition, themselves correlated with the growth conditions. MBE offers independent control of each element but, applied to oxides, is notoriously unstable and poorly reproducible because of the oxidising atmosphere. RHEED tracks the surface dynamics in real time (lattice parameter, surface reconstructions, roughness) but does not give access to the final bulk microstructure, which is only reachable ex situ via XRD / XRR. There is therefore a strong physical link – so far unexploited quantitatively – between RHEED dynamics and final XRD microstructure, which OXYD-IA proposes to learn directly. Figure 1 – OXYD-IA pipeline. At inference, the RHEED video acquired during growth (INL) feeds a deep video encoder (LIRIS) and a probabilistic regression module that predicts the final XRD spectrum together with its uncertainty. During training, the predicted spectrum is compared with the ex situ XRD / XRR spectrum measured at INL (ground truth); this discrepancy is the supervised learning signal that adjusts the model parameters. KEY RESEARCH AREAS AND RESPONSIBILITIES You will drive the core computational research along a risk-managed, phased 12-month roadmap. The primary target is a versioned RHEED / XRD dataset, growth-regime classification and probabilistic regression of the key structural parameters with calibrated uncertainty; full-spectrum prediction, a real-time demonstrator and cross-oxide generalisation are stretch and follow-on objectives. The work is organised around three technical pillars: 1. Corpus structuring and spatio-temporal RHEED representation • Build a versioned dataset by cleaning, temporally aligning and pairing the RHEED video sequences, the associated MBE parameters (temperature, oxygen pressure, source fluxes) and the ex situ XRD / XRR spectra (SrTiO3 reference system). • Pre-train, in a self-supervised manner, a spatio-temporal video encoder (3D CNN, e.g. R(2+1)D, or temporal Vision Transformer) fine-tuned on the laboratory corpus. • Perform fuzzy / Bayesian classification of the growth regimes (2D vs. 3D modes, transitions, RHEED oscillations), building on LIRIS expertise in the statistical analysis of sequences. 2. Probabilistic RHEED →XRD regression with uncertainty quantification • Design a latent representation that couples the video encoding with the physical MBE parameters. • Learn stepwise – first scalar structural parameters (lattice parameter, density, mosaicity), more robust at small N, then the full 1D XRD spectrum. • Provide calibrated uncertainty estimates (Bayesian approaches or deep ensembles), indispensable for guiding real-time decisions during growth. 3. Real-time demonstrator and dissemination (stretch / follow-on) • Validate the model on new SrTiO3 growths and prototype an in-growth inference tool at the end of the NANOFUTUR MBE line. • Mitigate the small-data and generalisation challenges through temporal data augmentation, transfer learning from pre-trained video encoders and domain adaptation towards other functional oxides. • Contribute toward a high-impact joint publication at the AI / materials interface (the project milestone is the submission of a joint paper). REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS • A Ph.D. in the field of Artificial Intelligence – Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision or Signal Processing, and we are looking for a senior postdoc with 2–5 years of post-PhD experience. • Deep learning on sequential / video data: demonstrable, hands-on experience with 3D CNNs, temporal transformers and / or probabilistic models. Proficiency in Python and PyTorch (or TensorFlow) is mandatory. • A genuine appetite for physics: a strong curiosity for, or prior exposure to, experimental physics and materials science. The ideal candidate carried out an AI-focused Ph.D. and is eager to apply it to a real materials-physics problem. • Research mindset: a track record of innovation and the ability to work autonomously on a complex, multidisciplinary project. • Software skills: experience with Git version control and reproducible research. • Excellent communication and scientific-writing skills in English. ADDITIONAL SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES • Self-supervised video pre-training, uncertainty quantification (Bayesian / ensembles), fuzzy classification, or domain adaptation. • Experience with small-sample / transfer-learning settings and handling large-scale experimental datasets. HOW TO APPLY Please prepare a single PDF file containing: 1. A detailed Curriculum Vitae, including a list of publications. 2. A 1-page motivation letter explaining your specific interest in this project and how your background addresses the key responsibilities and qualifications listed above. 3. The names and contact information of at least two academic references. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

The resulting tool will open the way to predictive, in situ control of oxide epitaxy – a process today dominated by a costly trial-and-error approach, in which the structural and functional properties of the films are only validated ex situ. You will join a genuinely multidisciplinary collaboration between the INL (Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon), which provides the operando experimental data and materials-physics expertise, and the LIRIS (équipe Imagine), which provides the deep video-learning and probabilistic-modelling methodology – both at École Centrale de Lyon.

A high-impact opportunity. AI for experimental physics is a fast-growing field, and OXYD-IA offers a genuine first-mover advantage within it: you would work on a unique, unpublished dataset of paired RHEED videos and XRD spectra to build one of the first video-to-spectrum models with calibrated uncertainty for oxide growth. By learning directly from experimental 1 data, such a model can short-circuit the traditional trial-and-error loop, accelerate discovery and drastically cut experimental time, cost, precursor consumption and instrument occupancy – turning routine in situ diagnostics into predictive tools.

Scientific context. Epitaxial perovskite-oxide thin films exhibit rich, tunable functional properties (thermoelectricity, ferroelectricity, piezoelectricity) governed by their structure and composition, themselves correlated with the growth conditions. MBE offers independent control of each element but, applied to oxides, is notoriously unstable and poorly reproducible because of the oxidising atmosphere. RHEED tracks the surface dynamics in real time (lattice parameter, surface reconstructions, roughness) but does not give access to the final bulk microstructure, which is only reachable ex situ via XRD / XRR. There is therefore a strong physical link – so far unexploited quantitatively – between RHEED dynamics and final XRD microstructure, which OXYD-IA proposes to learn directly.

Figure 1 – OXYD-IA pipeline. At inference, the RHEED video acquired during growth (INL) feeds a deep video encoder (LIRIS) and a probabilistic regression module that predicts the final XRD spectrum together with its uncertainty. During training, the predicted spectrum is compared with the ex situ XRD / XRR spectrum measured at INL (ground truth); this discrepancy is the supervised learning signal that adjusts the model parameters.

KEY RESEARCH AREAS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

You will drive the core computational research along a risk-managed, phased 12-month roadmap. The primary target is a versioned RHEED / XRD dataset, growth-regime classification and probabilistic regression of the key structural parameters with calibrated uncertainty; full-spectrum prediction, a real-time demonstrator and cross-oxide generalisation are stretch and follow-on objectives. The work is organised around three technical pillars:

1. Corpus structuring and spatio-temporal RHEED representation • Build a versioned dataset by cleaning, temporally aligning and pairing the RHEED video sequences, the associated MBE parameters (temperature, oxygen pressure, source fluxes) and the ex situ XRD / XRR spectra (SrTiO3 reference system). • Pre-train, in a self-supervised manner, a spatio-temporal video encoder (3D CNN, e.g. R(2+1)D, or temporal Vision Transformer) fine-tuned on the laboratory corpus. • Perform fuzzy / Bayesian classification of the growth regimes (2D vs. 3D modes, transitions, RHEED oscillations), building on LIRIS expertise in the statistical analysis of sequences.

2. Probabilistic RHEED →XRD regression with uncertainty quantification • Design a latent representation that couples the video encoding with the physical MBE parameters. • Learn stepwise – first scalar structural parameters (lattice parameter, density, mosaicity), more robust at small N, then the full 1D XRD spectrum. • Provide calibrated uncertainty estimates (Bayesian approaches or deep ensembles), indispensable for guiding real-time decisions during growth.

3. Real-time demonstrator and dissemination (stretch / follow-on) • Validate the model on new SrTiO3 growths and prototype an in-growth inference tool at the end of the NANOFUTUR MBE line. • Mitigate the small-data and generalisation challenges through temporal data augmentation, transfer learning from pre-trained video encoders and domain adaptation towards other functional oxides. • Contribute toward a high-impact joint publication at the AI / materials interface (the project milestone is the submission of a joint paper).


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• A Ph.D. in the field of Artificial Intelligence – Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision or Signal Processing, and we are looking for a senior postdoc with 2–5 years of post-PhD experience.

• Deep learning on sequential / video data: demonstrable, hands-on experience with 3D CNNs, temporal transformers and / or probabilistic models. Proficiency in Python and PyTorch (or TensorFlow) is mandatory.

• A genuine appetite for physics: a strong curiosity for, or prior exposure to, experimental physics and materials science. The ideal candidate carried out an AI-focused Ph.D. and is eager to apply it to a real materials-physics problem.

• Research mindset: a track record of innovation and the ability to work autonomously on a complex, multidisciplinary project. • Software skills: experience with Git version control and reproducible research.

• Excellent communication and scientific-writing skills in English.

ADDITIONAL SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

• Self-supervised video pre-training, uncertainty quantification (Bayesian / ensembles), fuzzy classification, or domain adaptation.

• Experience with small-sample / transfer-learning settings and handling large-scale experimental datasets.

HOW TO APPLY

Please prepare a single PDF file containing:

1. A detailed Curriculum Vitae, including a list of publications.

2. A 1-page motivation letter explaining your specific interest in this project and how your background addresses the key responsibilities and qualifications listed above.

3. The names and contact information of at least two academic references.

TransPerfect is the world's largest privately held provider of language services and technology solutions. With over 100 offices globally and more than 5,000 full-time employees, we work with the world's leading organisations across Legal, Corporate, Life Sciences, Financial, and Creative sectors to help them communicate, operate, and grow across languages, cultures, and markets.

 

Following our acquisition of The Mill — one of the world's most acclaimed creative studios — TransPerfect now offers an expanded suite of creative production services, including Artistic Direction, VFX, and Motion Design, serving luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands globally.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Director of Business Development to join our Corporate vertical in France. This is a pure new business hunter role — your mission is to identify, prospect, and close net new accounts across TransPerfect's full portfolio of services.

You will be selling into mid-to-large corporate accounts across a broad range of industries, with a particular focus on sectors where TransPerfect's expanded capabilities — including creative production via The Mill — create strong differentiation and cross-sell opportunity.

This role is ideal for a commercially driven professional who combines structured B2B sales discipline with genuine curiosity about creative, digital, and linguistic services.

What You Will Sell

You will represent TransPerfect's full Corporate service portfolio, including:

  • Translation & Localisation** — documents, marketing, legal, technical, and digital content

  • Interpretation** — simultaneous, consecutive, remote (RSI)

  • Technology & AI Solutions** — GlobalLink TMS, MT/MTPE, AI-powered workflows

  • Digital & Multimedia** — subtitling, dubbing, voice-over, e-learning localisation

  • Creative Production (The Mill)** — Artistic Direction, VFX, Motion Design for luxury, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands

  • Globalisation Consulting** — content strategy, workflow optimisation, language asset management

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and manage a pipeline of net new business across the French and European corporate market

  • Identify and engage key decision-makers — CMOs, Heads of Communication, Procurement Directors, Creative Directors, and Heads of Production

  • Develop tailored pitches and proposals that draw on the full breadth of TransPerfect's service offering, including creative capabilities

  • Lead the full sales cycle from prospecting to close, including RFP/RFI responses, commercial negotiation, and contract finalisation

  • Collaborate with internal teams (Solutions, Operations, The Mill creative teams) to design compelling, client-specific solutions

  • Represent TransPerfect at industry events, trade shows, and networking forums

  • Contribute to market intelligence — identify trends, competitor movements, and emerging client needs

  • Report pipeline, forecast, and activity accurately


Experience

  • Minimum 3–7 years of B2B sales experience, with a strong track record in new business development

  • Experience selling , multi-service solutions to corporate clients — ideally in one or more of the following: creative services, digital production, marketing services, SaaS/tech, or professional services

  • Proven ability to close six-figure deals and manage multi-stakeholder, long-cycle sales processes

  • Exposure to or genuine interest in creative industries (luxury, fashion, beauty, lifestyle, advertising) — a strong differentiator

  • Experience navigating large organisations — identifying budget holders, managing procurement processes, and building internal champions

 

Skills & Competencies

  • Hunter profile— proactive, autonomous, energised by opening new doors

  • Ability to sell both transactional and strategic engagements depending on client maturity

  • Strong discovery and consultative selling skills— listens before pitching

  • Comfortable discussing technology, AI, and workflow solutions as well as creative services

Languages

Education

title: Associate Director, Medical Affairs
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Associate Director, Medical Affairs based in France. As Associate Director, Medical Affairs, you will serve as a scientific leader and subject-matter expert across a broad range of Medical Affairs activities. You will independently lead high-value workstreams spanning thought leader engagement, scientific congresses, medical communications, publications, literature surveillance, and insight generation. The role combines external scientific engagement with strategic ownership of programs that support the product lifecycle. You will translate clinical evidence and stakeholder insights into practical recommendations that shape Medical Affairs priorities. You will also collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and provide trained backup support for selected Pharmacovigilance, Medical Information, and Product Complaint activities. This is a remote opportunity within a purpose-driven, collaborative healthcare environment, with approximately 20% travel for congresses and external engagements. Accountabilities Serve as a scientific subject-matter expert, translating clinical evidence, stakeholder insights, and emerging scientific developments into balanced, actionable recommendations for Medical Affairs strategy. Develop and maintain compliant relationships with key thought leaders (KTLs), healthcare professionals, and other external scientific experts. Plan and conduct scientific exchanges, advisory boards, roundtables, consensus initiatives, and other external engagements aligned with Medical Affairs objectives.
